name: Marmo Resource Glossary
description: A compact glossary of the four Marmo resource kinds and their roles.
input_summary: A Marmo resource authoring or onboarding question.
output_summary: Definitions of Memory, Skill, Tool, and Agent.
content: Memory supplies searchable context. Skill supplies reusable instructions. Tool exposes a single executable operation. Agent exposes a specialist delegation target. Retrieval finds candidates; policy separately determines whether activation or execution is allowed.
